title: Improving the Resolution and Accuracy of Groundwater Level Anomalies Using the Machine Learning-Based Fusion Model in the North China Plain
summary: A machine-learning fusion system downscaled GRACE water-storage observations and combined groundwater, precipitation, runoff and evapotranspiration data to estimate groundwater-level anomalies in China’s North China Plain. Against six in-situ datasets, the prediction module improved average correlation from 0.43 to 0.71; transfer beyond the study area was not shown.
ai_technology: A machine-learning fusion/downscaling model estimates groundwater-level anomalies and compares them with observed water levels.
